name: Rymzi
logo: A filled travel pin with a four-point star cutout; the wordmark repeats the star over the i.

typography.wordmark: Outlined DM Sans Bold with a custom star over the dotless i.

source: Original code-native SVG geometry; editable mark and outlined DM Sans Bold lettering. Dedicated generate_logo tool was unavailable.

directions.sparkpin: A discovery pin with a negative-space star; selected for clear small-size silhouette.

directions.roamloop: A bold folded R with a blue departure leg.

reviewed_assets: Three original directions compared. Selected mark visually reviewed at 16, 24, 48 and 240px, plus header lockup, app icon and one-color version. Live browser and physical-device verification remain pending.
theme: Black, luminous lavender and electric violet-blue. Brighter foregrounds, semibold headings and distinct action fills. No pure-white UI surfaces.
